summary.en: An 8 px colored dot followed by words, for the live state of a system, a service or a connection. The words say the state; the dot helps scanning.
summary.id: Titik berwarna 8 px diikuti kata-kata, untuk kondisi langsung sebuah sistem, layanan atau koneksi. Kata-kata menyebut kondisinya; titik membantu memindai.

en.title: States
en.desc: Neutral for unknown or stopped, then ok, warning, down and live.
en.html: Not started All systems running Tax data sync delayed Payments unavailable Live now

en.desc: At the end of each row, so the states line up.
